messages:
devsec_kayla: Heads-up, saw increased mTLS handshake failures between eu-proxy and us-west model-pool after yesterday's RBAC role sync. :rotating_light:
infra_raj: Oof — which error? TLS alert? KMS decrypt?
sre_lucas: Logs show `handshake_failure` then `local_tls_error: certificate verify failed`. A bunch of 403s from the keystore decryption step.
eng_maya: Paging recent change — we added `role:keystore-reader` to the proxy node role and removed the old `keystore-service` IAM grant in eu. Could be a permissions gap on the KMS key.
security_bob: Can you paste the audit log snippet? Need KMS RequestID and principal.
devsec_kayla: Paste: ```text
2026-03-20T14:02:11Z KMSDecrypt AccessDenied Principal=proxy-eu@redwood-prod Role=role:keystore-reader KeyId=arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456:key/abcd
2026-03-20T14:02:11Z TLSHandshake failure peer=us-west-model-01 reason=cert-verify-failed
```
oncall-bot: Incident created SEC-3142 and paged oncall. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-3142
infra_raj: Quick triage: looks like the role mapping removed the kms:Decrypt permission on that key. Region replication of key policy didn't include the new role name.
eng_maya: Confirmed. Key policy in eu-west-1 binds `arn:aws:iam::123456:role/keystore-service` but not the new `arn:aws:iam::123456:role/role-keystore-reader`.
security_bob: Two immediate mitigations: 1) add a temporary policy allowing `kms:Decrypt` for the role; 2) re-enable old role binding if rotate rollback is safe. Which is faster?
devsec_kayla: Policy add is fastest. I'll submit a scoped change to give `kms:Decrypt` scoped to `KeyId=abcd` and tag it for rollback.
sre_lucas: Also push an envoy config tweak to disable strict client cert verification for the proxy pair as a short-lived fallback (not ideal but reduces errors while KMS fix propagates). Example: ```yaml
transport_socket:
  name: "envoy.transport_sockets.tls"
  typed_config:
    "@type": type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.transport_sockets.tls.v3.DownstreamTlsContext
    common_tls_context:
      validation_context:
        trusted_ca: { filename: "/etc/ssl/certs/ca.pem" }
      alpn_protocols: \"h2,http/1.1\"
    require_client_certificate: false  # TEMPORARY
```
eng_maya: Please file the config change as a canary in eu-proxy only and add an auto-revert in 30m.
infra_raj: I'll make the KMS policy change now and push a snapshot to the audit channel.
devsec_kayla: Change PR: https://git.redwood.internal/infra/keystore-policies/pulls/78 — granting kms:Decrypt to `arn:aws:iam::123456:role/role-keystore-reader` on key abcd. Marked as emergency, 1h TTL.
security_bob: After change we should validate both: 1) KMS decrypt success on eu-proxy (showing logs), 2) TLS handshakes back to normal and no certificate verification errors. Also add a test to CI that ensures KMS role is present in key policy when role-sync runs.
sre_lucas: Validation run: ```bash
aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://blob.bin --key-id arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456:key/abcd --profile prod-eu && echo OK
``` returned OK after the policy change, timestamp 14:07Z.
oncall-bot: Incident SEC-3142 updated: Mitigation applied; monitoring.
eng_maya: Headline postmortem notes for follow-up: - tighten RBAC change process so role rename requires policy patch in all regions; - add automated lint that denies role-sync if key policies would drop permissions; - ensure keystore role naming stable (avoid ephemeral role renames).
devsec_kayla: Will own the postmortem. I'll pull audit logs and include the exact role-sync diff and timing.
security_bob: Also add KMS key policy replication check to the infra preflight. This caused cross-region failures when proxy pairs talk across regions.
infra_raj: Thanks team. Rolling back envoy temporary relax at 14:35Z. Closing once 1h stable. :thumbsup:
